terms.gloss: the palm of the hand; the open hand
evidence: Verg. A. 8.69: cavīs undam dē flūmine palmīs sustulit (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The same word is the palm tree and the victor’s palm.

sources: Lewis & Short: palma
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 356.
